extracted.name: Steakhouse Wheat Bread for the Bread Machine
extracted.description: Instant coffee, cocoa, and honey may seem like strange partners in a bread recipe until you actually try this one made like a favorite steakhouse version.
instruction_lines: Place warm water, butter, honey, salt, coffee, cocoa, sugar, bread flour, whole wheat flour, and bread machine yeast in the pan of a bread machine in the order listed. Put on regular or basic cycle with light crust.
